dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth as an RFC 3339 full-date (yyyy-MM-dd, zero-padded); a time component is rejected

gender.description: Gender; free string validated against the shared reference list at the caller layer

orgId.description: Organisation id this user belongs to (org catalogue reference)

departmentName.description: Department the user belongs to, e.g. Horticulture, Soil Science, Plant Pathology

entityType.description: User category; free string validated against the shared reference list at the caller layer

password.description: Hashed password (hashed by the portal backend before submission; source of truth)

pin.description: Hashed PIN (hashed by the portal backend before submission; source of truth)

passwordExpiresOn.description: RFC 3339 date-time the password expires; UTC offset is mandatory (e.g. 2026-08-19T10:15:30Z)

pinExpiresOn.description: RFC 3339 date-time the PIN expires; UTC offset is mandatory (e.g. 2026-08-19T10:15:30Z)

createdBy.description: User id of the creator (set by the portal/auth layer)

updatedBy.description: User id of the last updater (set by the portal/auth layer)
